by
  have h₁ : (2 : ℝ)^2014 + (2 : ℝ)^2012 = (5 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ)^2012 := by
    have h₁₁ : (2 : ℝ)^2014 = (2 : ℝ)^2 * (2 : ℝ)^2012 := by
      rw [show (2014 : ℕ) = 2 + 2012 by norm_num]
      rw [pow_add]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₁₁]
    ring_nf
    <;> norm_num
    <;> linarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) 2012]
  
  have h₂ : (2 : ℝ)^2014 - (2 : ℝ)^2012 = (3 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ)^2012 := by
    have h₂₁ : (2 : ℝ)^2014 = (2 : ℝ)^2 * (2 : ℝ)^2012 := by
      rw [show (2014 : ℕ) = 2 + 2012 by norm_num]
      rw [pow_add]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₂₁]
    ring_nf
    <;> norm_num
    <;> linarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) 2012]
  
  have h₃ : ((2 : ℝ)^2014 + (2 : ℝ)^2012) / ((2 : ℝ)^2014 - (2 : ℝ)^2012) = (5 : ℝ) / 3 := by
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    have h₃₁ : (2 : ℝ)^2012 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h₃₂ : (3 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ)^2012 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [h₃₁, h₃₂]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> norm_num
    <;> linarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) 2012]
  
  have h₄ : (2^2014 + 2^2012 : ℝ) / (2^2014 - 2^2012 : ℝ) = (5 : ℝ) / 3 := by
    have h₄₁ : ((2 : ℝ)^2014 + (2 : ℝ)^2012) / ((2 : ℝ)^2014 - (2 : ℝ)^2012) = (5 : ℝ) / 3 := h₃
    norm_num [pow_succ] at h₄₁ ⊢
    <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try ring_nf at h₄₁ ⊢) <;>
    (try simp_all [pow_succ]) <;>
    (try norm_num at h₄₁ ⊢) <;>
    (try linarith)
    <;>
    (try
      {
        field_simp at h₄₁ ⊢ <;>
        ring_nf at h₄₁ ⊢ <;>
        norm_num at h₄₁ ⊢ <;>
        linarith
      })
    <;>
    (try
      {
        norm_cast at h₄₁ ⊢ <;>
        simp_all [pow_succ] <;>
        norm_num at h₄₁ ⊢ <;>
        linarith
      })
  
  have h₅ : (2^2014 + 2^2012) / (2^2014 - 2^2012) = (5: ℝ) / 3 := by
    norm_num [div_eq_mul_inv] at h₄ ⊢
    <;>
    (try simp_all [div_eq_mul_inv]) <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try ring_nf at * ) <;>
    (try field_simp at * ) <;>
    (try norm_cast at * ) <;>
    (try linarith)
    <;>
    (try
      {
        simp_all [div_eq_mul_inv]
        <;> norm_num
        <;> linarith
      })
    <;>
    (try
      {
        norm_num at *
        <;> linarith
      })
  
  exact h₅

by
  have h₁ : (2 : ℝ)^2014 = 4 * (2 : ℝ)^2012 := by
    have h₁₀ : (2 : ℝ) ^ 2014 = (2 : ℝ) ^ (2012 + 2) := by norm_num
    rw [h₁₀]
    have h₁₁ : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2012 + 2) = (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [pow_add]
    rw [h₁₁]
    norm_num
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> norm_num
  
  have h₂ : ((2 : ℝ)^2014 + (2 : ℝ)^2012) = 5 * (2 : ℝ)^2012 := by
    have h₂₁ : ((2 : ℝ) ^ 2014 + (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012) = 4 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012 + (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012 := by
      rw [h₁]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₂₁]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> norm_num
    <;> linarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) 2012]
  
  have h₃ : ((2 : ℝ)^2014 - (2 : ℝ)^2012) = 3 * (2 : ℝ)^2012 := by
    have h₃₁ : ((2 : ℝ)^2014 - (2 : ℝ)^2012) = 4 * (2 : ℝ)^2012 - (2 : ℝ)^2012 := by
      rw [h₁]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₃₁]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> norm_num
    <;> linarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) 2012]
  
  have h₄ : (2 : ℝ)^2012 ≠ 0 := by
    have h₄₁ : (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012 > 0 := by positivity
    linarith
  
  have h₅ : ((2 : ℝ)^2014 + (2 : ℝ)^2012) / ((2 : ℝ)^2014 - (2 : ℝ)^2012) = (5 : ℝ) / 3 := by
    have h₅₁ : ((2 : ℝ) ^ 2014 + (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012) / ((2 : ℝ) ^ 2014 - (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012) = (5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012) / (3 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012) := by
      rw [h₂, h₃]
      <;> ring_nf
    rw [h₅₁]
    have h₅₂ : (5 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012 : ℝ) / (3 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012 : ℝ) = (5 : ℝ) / 3 := by
      have h₅₃ : (3 * (2 : ℝ) ^ 2012 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [h₅₃]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> field_simp [h₄]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> norm_num
    rw [h₅₂]
    <;> ring_nf
  
  rw [h₅]
  <;> norm_num

  have h₃ : (x : ℤ) + (y : ℤ) = 36 := by
    have h₃₁ : (↑x - (3 : ℤ)) + (y - (3 : ℤ)) = 30 := h₂
    have h₃₂ : (↑x : ℤ) + (y : ℤ) - 6 = 30 := by
      ring_nf at h₃₁ ⊢
      <;> simp_all [sub_eq_add_neg]
      <;> linarith
    have h₃₃ : (↑x : ℤ) + (y : ℤ) = 36 := by
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast h₃₃
  
  have h₄ : x + y = 36 := by
    norm_cast at h₃ ⊢
    <;>
    (try omega) <;>
    (try linarith) <;>
    (try ring_nf at h₃ ⊢ <;> omega)
  
  have h₅ : 6 * x = 36 := by
    have h₅₁ : y = 5 * x := by
      omega
    have h₅₂ : x + y = 36 := h₄
    rw [h₅₁] at h₅₂
    ring_nf at h₅₂ ⊢
    omega
  
  have h₆ : x = 6 := by
    have h₆₁ : 6 * x = 36 := h₅
    have h₆₂ : x = 6 := by
      omega
    exact h₆₂
  
  exact h₆
